criteria.description: Consent-availability gate exists in the delivery context; a run aborts when consent is unresolvable.
A project with NO consent record is denied for delivery, overriding the default-allow fall-through at routing.py:87.
is_sync_enabled_for_checkout denies when routing is unresolvable (routing.py:114-116); no network request is made.
A selected batch spanning >1 project is refused before any POST, names the projects, exits non-zero, and does not mutate retry counts.
Empty selection short-circuits before payload build and reports the real cause, not the no-Private-Teamspace message.
project_uuid/project_slug exist as additive indexed journal columns; a PRE-MIGRATION journal file still opens and reads.
_select_undelivered's universe comes from the project-filtered read; the stored column is the sole selection authority.
The filtered read returns an identity projection (no payload BLOB) and its SQL carries no LIMIT.
Backfill run twice over a 10k-row multi-project journal yields byte-identical column values and unchanged row count.
Identity-less capture is stamped into a named non-deliverable state; NO event is dropped at write time.
Unresolved-identity events are counted (fixture: >=1 nil-sentinel + >=1 NULL) and those rows are absent from the delivered set.
No code path constructs the queue-backed drain; the legacy queue is asserted empty and the removal fails loudly rather than discarding.
Consent index is uuid-keyed; two checkouts of one project with opposite overrides resolve to DENY; unresolvable paths keep an 'unresolved' marker the predicate ignores.
A stable server refusal reason maps to TERMINAL_FAILED in receivers.py and is counted in terminal-failure totals.
sync doctor/status/migrate report per-project depth, oldest age and consent state, reconciled against the journal retained count (NOT OfflineQueue stats).
sync purge --project removes 100% of the target project's rows across journal AND ledger and 0% of any other project's.
sync purge --all empties the store behind explicit confirmation and reports the total removed.
Sync docs state the machine-global scope of SPEC_KITTY_ENABLE_SAAS_SYNC and SPEC_KITTY_SAAS_URL; a CI anchor test fails if the statement is removed.

delivered_project_uuids is a SUBSET of consented_project_uuids AND None is not in delivered. Subset/membership, never cardinality -- identity-less events collapse to {None} and would fake cardinality==1.
2,000 non-consented events older than 10 consented: ONE drain delivers all 10. Predicate applied before the row limit.
100k rows / 20 projects: selecting one project performs no full-table payload decode.
Backfill is idempotent and lossless; no row deleted or mutated outside the two new columns.
Capture-first preserved: no event dropped at write time. A missing_auth-stamped row DOES deliver once the gate clears.
After purging project X, differential row count over all other projects across journal and ledger is zero.
The drain's real batch window (_EVENT_SYNC_DISPATCH_BATCH_LIMIT, cli/commands/sync.py:807-820, halved on 413) is exercised. NOT batch.py's max_events_per_batch, which is dead after WP02.
Incident reproduction: 6 projects, 1 consented, 5 with NO consent record -> only the consented project's events are delivered. FAILS on origin/main at mission start.
Liveness proof, written red-first at the selection seam.
Each fail-closed path denies with NO network request: unresolvable routing, absent consent record, unresolvable identity, multi-project batch, empty selection.
Zero hand-written SQLite queries needed to answer 'whose data is in here?'.
No code path constructs the queue-backed drain.
Purge exactness measured by differential row counts across journal and ledger.
Backfill twice -> byte-identical values, unchanged count.

LIVE drain against spec-kitty-dev at the incident's shape (>=6 projects: 1 consented, >=3 no record, >=1 opt-out, >=1 identity-less). Artefact carries before/after counts per project_slug, the drain's own delivered count, and the CLI commit SHA. NEVER production.
CROSS-INVOCATION: a second sync now selects strictly fewer events than the first. A single-run assertion is already green on origin/main via the dispatcher's exclude set.
RECORDED, NOT DISCHARGED: after this mission the machine still accumulates every project's payloads in one producer-scoped store. Egress is secured; collection is not. Operator decision.

negative_invariants: No event belonging to a project without a consent record is ever POSTed.
No event is dropped at write time (capture-first durability).
No transient drain-blocked reason (missing_auth/missing_team/saas_disabled) permanently excludes an event.
No test asserts delivered-project CARDINALITY in place of subset membership.
No mission activity authenticates against or mutates production.
